name: POST to Rayvn log
info:
Posts a bridged entry to the Rayvn log API.

### Input
`msg.payload` = Rayvn POST body with `files[]` containing `{ context_key, buffer, name, type }`
`msg.metadata.target` = Rayvn Client
`msg.entry` = original bridge entry (used for _failed_files reporting)

### Logic
1. Uploads each file buffer to Rayvn /files, replaces files array with Rayvn file IDs
2. Sets Authorization header, URL `/logs/{log_id}/entry`, sends POST
3. Checks for failed uploads and sets `entry._failed_files` if any

### Output 1
`msg.topic = "response"`, `msg.result = true/false`, `msg.statusCode`

### Output 2
Notification payload for Build attachment notification (only when uploads failed)
